Last Friday, Anna and Amy went to the green hill. Anna likes sunny days best. Anna hopes to visit Tokyo one day. In fact, the gas oven lights instantly.

Anna thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. They took many photos at the bird-watching spot. There are always many people at the bird-watching spot. In fact, the city grew into an industrial centre.
Anna learned a lot about English. The green hill is one of the best places in the city. It takes twenty minutes to get to the green hill by bike. Also, it will probably rain tonight.
Anna is going to travel to Tokyo in November. Anna usually has rice for breakfast. Life is full of small surprises.
